turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to cite Embodied-CoT in my draft. I think it was at NeurIPS 2024, right?
I can help with that. Based on your notes, you mentioned it was presented at NeurIPS 2024.
Yeah, that's what I have in my bib file. Also, did my package for the robot arm arrive?
I don't have tracking info for physical packages. I can check your email if you want.
Nah, I'll check later. Just make sure the citation format is correct for NeurIPS 2024.
Understood. I've noted that Embodied-CoT is cited as NeurIPS 2024 for now.
Thanks. Oh, is it raining outside? I forgot my umbrella.
It looks clear from my local data, but I can't see out the window. Check a weather app!
Lloyd, quick update. I found the actual paper for Embodied-CoT. It was actually presented at CoRL 2025, not NeurIPS.
Got it. I'll update my records to reflect that Embodied-CoT was presented at CoRL 2025.
Great. I need to fix the BibTeX entry. Can you generate the correct conference field for me?
Sure. The conference field should be 'CoRL 2025'. Do you need the full citation?
Just the field is fine for now. I'm updating my reference manager. Did the pizza I ordered 20 minutes ago arrive?
I can't track food deliveries, but 20 minutes is often enough time for pizza!
Haha, fair. Okay, thanks for the correction on the venue.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need help with the rest of the references.
